name: Two-story architecture (crime timeline vs investigation timeline)
name_ar: البنية ذات القصتين: خط الجريمة وخط التحقيق
summary_ar: كل لغز يتكون من قصة جريمة مخفية وقصة تحقيق ظاهرة تكشفها تدريجياً. في ATHAR يتحول هذا إلى نموذج بيانات من طبقتين: حقيقة أرضية لا يراها المستخدم، وشبكة قرائن مرتبطة بها. ويُفحص آلياً أن لكل حدث حاسم أثراً قابلاً للاكتشاف.
mystery_principle: Curiosity about a hidden past event drives the reader; the investigation exists to reconstruct it.
information_distribution: Ground truth fully authored; player sees only evidence nodes linked to events, released by a schedule.
surprise_mechanism: Reinterpretation when a withheld past event is revealed.
fairness_criterion: Every critical crime event has >=1 discoverable evidence node before the solution gate.
weaknesses: Abstract; needs tooling
Todorov content summarised from prior knowledge
athar_use: Mandatory case schema: crime_events[] + evidence_nodes[] + release schedule; auto-check for orphan events and unsupported conclusions.

name: Closed circle of suspects
summary_ar: تُحصر الجريمة في مجموعة صغيرة معزولة (قطار، جزيرة، بيت)، فيكون الفاعل بالضرورة أحدهم. هذا يقلل نطاق البحث ويجعل القضية قابلة للحل في جلسة قصيرة على الهاتف. لكنه نادر في التحقيق الواقعي، ويجب التنبيه إلى ذلك تعليمياً.
mystery_principle: Isolation guarantees the culprit is among a known, finite set; each suspect gets means, motive and opportunity.
information_distribution: All suspects introduced early; each receives a motive thread, an alibi claim and at least one hidden secret.
surprise_mechanism: The least-suspected member, or more than one member, is guilty.
fairness_criterion: Suspect list complete and fixed before mid-case; culprit present in first act.
weaknesses: Artificial; rare in real investigations
Golden Age versions excluded servants and outsiders by class bias
athar_use: Default format for Season 1 short cases (4–6 suspects); add an in-game note that real investigations rarely have closed circles.

name: Locked room / impossible crime
summary_ar: حدث يبدو مستحيلاً فيزيائياً، مثل غرفة مغلقة من الداخل أو ثلج بلا آثار أقدام. الحل دائماً افتراض خاطئ لدى القارئ عن الزمن أو المكان أو هوية الضحية أو طبيعة الحدث. يحتاج الأمر إلى مخطط تفاعلي، وإلى تجنب الآليات القابلة للتقليد.
mystery_principle: An apparent impossibility is resolved by exposing a false assumption about time, place, identity or the nature of the event.
information_distribution: Floor plans and physical constraints shown up front; the false assumption is induced by narrative framing, not hidden facts.
surprise_mechanism: Single overlooked assumption collapses the impossibility.
fairness_criterion: All physical elements of the mechanism are visible in the plan or evidence before the gate; no undisclosed secret passages.
weaknesses: Mechanical solutions can be contrived (Barzun & Taylor on Carr)
Hard to render on small screens
Safety: avoid replicable concealment methods
athar_use: Use ATHAR's own 5-question 'assumption card'; one impossibility per case at tiers 1–3; non-lethal impossibilities for 13–15.

name: Challenge-to-the-reader gate
summary_ar: يتوقف السرد قبل الحل ليعلن أن القارئ يملك كل المعلومات اللازمة، ويدعوه إلى الالتزام بحل. في ATHAR تصبح هذه البوابة لحظة تقديم الفرضية مع درجة الثقة، وتُقفل حتى تُتاح كل القرائن الحاسمة.
mystery_principle: An explicit contract: the author certifies that all necessary information has been given.
information_distribution: Gate opens only after every critical clue has been made available (not necessarily found).
surprise_mechanism: Payoff of committing before the reveal; hint ladder optional (Shimada).
fairness_criterion: Automated check: every critical clue is reachable before the gate; playtest solve-rate band set per tier.
weaknesses: Can feel like an exam
Promise must be true or trust collapses
athar_use: Core mechanic: 'Submit theory' screen with culprit, method, motive, key evidence and confidence; graduated hints with score cost.

name: Unreliable narrator by omission
summary_ar: الراوي يقول الحقيقة حرفياً لكنه يحذف ما يدينه. الحيلة قوية جداً، لكنها في منصة تفاعلية تهدد الثقة بالنظام. يُسمح بها في ATHAR فقط لشخصيات داخل العالم ولمستويات متقدمة، ولا تُسمح أبداً لصوت المنصة.
mystery_principle: The trusted teller conceals by omission and ambiguous phrasing, never by explicit falsehood.
information_distribution: Gaps sit at time-critical moments; true but double-edged sentences.
surprise_mechanism: Recognition that the guide/narrator was the culprit; re-reading reveals the gaps.
fairness_criterion: No false statements from the narrator; every gap detectable by timeline comparison.
weaknesses: Widely perceived as cheating
Breaks under loose translation
Erodes trust if the system voice lies
athar_use: Allowed only for in-world documents (diaries, reports) at 16+; 'omission audit' task: find unaccounted minutes in a character's account.

name: Competing solutions from the same facts
summary_ar: عدة محققين يبنون حلولاً متماسكة ومختلفة من الأدلة نفسها، فيظهر أن الوقائع لا تفرض تفسيراً واحداً. في ATHAR يُطلب من المستخدم تسجيل فرضيات بديلة وإسقاطها بأدلة قبل الحل.
mystery_principle: One body of evidence underdetermines the answer; the best solution explains more with fewer assumptions.
information_distribution: Same evidence presented to all theorists; each solution selects and weights differently.
surprise_mechanism: Successive overturning; the humblest theorist is right.
fairness_criterion: Final solution must explain every critical clue and contradict none; each rejected solution must fail on a specific clue.
weaknesses: Low emotional stakes
Long expositions
athar_use: Hypothesis board: >=2 alternatives with eliminating evidence before final submission; classroom debate mode.

name: Cold case via conflicting testimonies
summary_ar: تُعاد القضية بعد سنوات من الحكم، عبر روايات مكتوبة لعدة شهود. الحقيقة تظهر في التقاطعات والتناقضات، لا في أثر مادي جديد. هذا نمط خالٍ من العنف البصري ومناسب جداً للتعليم.
mystery_principle: Truth reconstructed from partial, biased, time-worn accounts of the same events.
information_distribution: Each witness file covers overlapping time windows from a different vantage and motive.
surprise_mechanism: Reinterpretation of an earlier verdict; hidden protective motive.
fairness_criterion: Solution must be anchored in at least three cross-testimony contradictions or agreements, plus one document.
weaknesses: Interpretive solutions are hard to auto-score
Christie's version is not strict fair-play
athar_use: Seasonal 'cold file' format with a cross-testimony matrix tool; score the evidential links, not just the verdict.

name: Archival re-investigation of an accepted story
name_ar: إعادة التحقيق الأرشيفي في رواية سائدة
summary_ar: يحقق المستخدم في رواية «مقبولة» عبر وثائق ومصادر، ويسأل من كتبها ولماذا. يجب أن يُلزم النمط بعرض الأدلة المضادة، وإلا تحول إلى تحيز تأكيدي كما في رواية تاي.
mystery_principle: Received narratives are claims by interested parties; re-weigh sources.
information_distribution: Primary documents of differing reliability, dates and authorship; one tempting visual impression.
surprise_mechanism: Overturning consensus — or confirming it after testing.
fairness_criterion: Must include the strongest counter-evidence; the player's conclusion must address it.
weaknesses: Can teach motivated reasoning (Tey's selectivity)
Cultural/historical sensitivity in the Arab world
athar_use: Archive cases set in fictional or non-contentious local history; mandatory counter-evidence file; 'who benefits from this account?' prompt.

name: Inverted mystery (howcatchem)
summary_ar: يُعرض الحدث ومرتكبه أولاً، ويصبح اللغز كيف سيُثبت التحقيق ما حدث. هذا يقلل الغموض حول الهوية ويركز على سلسلة الأدلة، فهو مناسب للمبتدئين ولتعليم الربط بين الفعل وأثره.
mystery_principle: The reader knows who; suspense and puzzle shift to how the truth will be proven.
information_distribution: Crime vignette shown first; the player later identifies which actions left traces.
surprise_mechanism: The overlooked trace that undoes a careful plan; or an ironic legal outcome.
fairness_criterion: Every trace used in the proof must be visible or inferable from the opening vignette.
weaknesses: Less 'whodunit' thrill
Risk of glamorising perpetrators
athar_use: 'Watch then prove' cases: short non-graphic vignette, then evidence hunt; perpetrator never glamorised.

name: Negative evidence (the expected event that did not happen)
name_ar: الدليل السلبي: ما كان يجب أن يحدث ولم يحدث
summary_ar: غياب حدث متوقع قد يكون دليلاً إذا وُجد توقع قوي بحدوثه، مثل الكلب الذي لم ينبح. المهارة المطلوبة أن يصرّح المستخدم بالتوقع الذي يجعل الغياب ذا معنى.
mystery_principle: Absence is informative only relative to a strong expectation.
information_distribution: Establish the routine/expectation early (e.g., a guard dog always reacts to strangers) without flagging it.
surprise_mechanism: Recognition that silence identifies a familiar actor.
fairness_criterion: The expectation must be established in-case before the absence matters.
strengths: Counters 'only what is present counts' bias
weaknesses: Players may over-read absences; Van Dine listed it as a stale device
athar_use: Clue type 'expected-but-missing': the player must state the expectation; scoring checks the stated expectation.

name: Hidden in plain sight / adversary modelling
name_ar: المخفي على مرأى الجميع ونمذجة الخصم
summary_ar: يفشل البحث المنهجي إذا كان نموذج البحث خاطئاً. الحل يأتي من تخيل كيف يفكر هذا الشخص بعينه. يعلّم النمط التفكير ما وراء المعرفي، أي مراجعة افتراضات البحث نفسها.
mystery_principle: Thoroughness fails when the search model is wrong; model the hider's mind.
information_distribution: Show exhaustive but assumption-bound search results; give profile cues about the hider.
surprise_mechanism: The object was visible all along.
fairness_criterion: Profile cues sufficient to predict the hiding strategy are present.
weaknesses: One-trick; easy to spoil
Safety: keep to objects/information, not evading detection
athar_use: Pre-search prompt: 'How would THIS person hide it?'; search then reveals whether the prediction holds.

name: Pattern camouflage (a series hides one target)
name_ar: التمويه بالنمط: سلسلة تخفي هدفاً واحداً
summary_ar: سلسلة أحداث تبدو عشوائية أو منهجية تُخفي حدثاً واحداً مقصوداً يستفيد منه شخص بعينه. السؤال المفتاحي: أي حدث في السلسلة يفيد أحداً تحديداً؟
mystery_principle: A conspicuous pattern draws attention away from a single motivated event.
information_distribution: Several pattern events with weak links to anyone; one event tied to a beneficiary through modest clues.
surprise_mechanism: The 'serial' pattern is a disguise.
fairness_criterion: Beneficiary clue for the target event must be present; the patsy's innocence must be inferable.
weaknesses: Christie's patsy is an epileptic man — risk of disability stigma
athar_use: Non-lethal series (e.g., a string of prank vandalisms hiding one targeted theft); never use a health condition as a suspicion marker.

name: Victim-as-culprit (staged attempts)
summary_ar: الشخص الذي يبدو مستهدفاً يدبّر محاولات وهمية ضد نفسه لصرف الشبهة. يعلّم النمط سؤال: من يستفيد من أن يُرى ضحية؟
mystery_principle: Perceived victimhood confers immunity from suspicion.
information_distribution: Attempts are witnessed only via the 'victim' or under conditions she controls; a name ambiguity in documents.
surprise_mechanism: The protected becomes the suspect.
fairness_criterion: At least two attempts must show staging inconsistencies discoverable before the gate.
strengths: Teaches checking who corroborates a claim
weaknesses: Can promote cynicism toward real victims — frame carefully
athar_use: Use with property or reputation 'attacks' (not violence); debrief stresses that real victims deserve belief and evidence-based checks.

name: Allies disguised as enemies (constructed alibi)
name_ar: حلفاء متنكرون في هيئة أعداء: صناعة الحجة الغيابية
summary_ar: شخصان يتظاهران بالعداء العلني ليصنعا حجة غياب متبادلة. أداة كشفه مصفوفة الزمن والمكان التي تفحص من كان أين ومتى، ومن شهد على ماذا.
mystery_principle: A public quarrel and staged injury create mutual alibis.
information_distribution: Timeline with witness-dependent alibis; a small physical inconsistency (e.g., a borrowed item).
surprise_mechanism: The enemies were partners.
fairness_criterion: Alibi matrix must contain the contradiction; no reliance on information only the detective saw.
weaknesses: Over-complexity (Barnard)
athar_use: Alibi-matrix mechanic with drag-and-drop time slots; complexity capped per tier.

name: Double bluff (evidence meant to be disproved)
summary_ar: يزرع الفاعل أدلة ضد نفسه أو ضد شريكه، ويتوقع دحضها، فيكسب حصانة لاحقة. يناسب المستويات المتقدمة لأنه يتطلب تفكيراً من الدرجة الثانية.
mystery_principle: Being cleared once protects a suspect from renewed suspicion.
information_distribution: Early weak case against X collapses publicly; later clues re-point to X through a different channel.
surprise_mechanism: The cleared suspect was guilty.
fairness_criterion: The second channel of evidence must be independent of the planted first case.
weaknesses: Hard; can feel unfair if the second channel is thin
athar_use: Advanced tier only; debrief explains the logic of 'absence of proof is not proof of absence'.

name: Collective culprit and the justice/law split
name_ar: الفاعل الجماعي والفرق بين العدالة والقانون
summary_ar: كل أفراد الدائرة تقريباً مشاركون، ويُعرض حلان: حل حقيقي، وحل يُقدَّم للسلطات. ينتج نقاش أخلاقي، لكنه يتطلب قرائن تنسيق واضحة لكي يكون عادلاً.
mystery_principle: Inverts the single-culprit convention; truth and the 'reported' solution diverge.
information_distribution: Many small inconsistencies across all suspects point to coordination rather than one liar.
surprise_mechanism: Everyone did it.
fairness_criterion: Coordination clues (shared knowledge, too-perfect alibis) must be visible across suspects.
weaknesses: Can feel contrived (Chandler)
Endorsing vigilante justice is unsuitable for teens
athar_use: Use as an ethics-debate case at 16+; ATHAR's scored answer is the evidential truth; the 'what should be done' discussion is unscored.

name: Shrinking circle countdown
summary_ar: عدد المشتبه بهم يتناقص مع تقدم الأحداث، مما يرفع التوتر ويحول الفضول إلى تشويق. تعتمد النسخة الأصلية على اعتراف ختامي لا على استنتاج، وهذا ضعف يجب علاجه.
mystery_principle: Rising stakes as the suspect pool shrinks.
information_distribution: Episodic reveals; each episode removes or clears one suspect.
surprise_mechanism: A faked exit — the 'removed' person is the culprit.
fairness_criterion: Faked-exit clue must be present before the final episode; solution must not rely on confession.
weaknesses: Original resolves by confession (not fair-play)
Lethal countdown unsuitable for 13–15
athar_use: Non-lethal version: suspects 'leave' (eliminated by alibi or exit) episode by episode; the season finale requires deduction.

name: Legend as misdirection (rationalised supernatural)
name_ar: الأسطورة كأداة تضليل: تفسير عقلاني للخارق
summary_ar: شائعة أو أسطورة محلية تُستخدم لإخفاء فعل بشري. تعامل القضية الشائعة كدليل على ما يعتقده الناس، لا على ما حدث. هذا مناسب ثقافياً في سياقات فيها حكايات الجن والأماكن المسكونة.
mystery_principle: Rumour is evidence about beliefs, not events; supernatural explanations are excluded by contract.
information_distribution: Legend presented early by multiple characters; physical traces contradict it.
surprise_mechanism: A human actor exploits the legend.
fairness_criterion: Contract: no supernatural solutions (Detection Club oath, Knox 2); all 'uncanny' effects get physical explanations.
weaknesses: Religious sensitivity: never mock belief; target exploitation of fear, not faith
athar_use: Culturally local legends (e.g., an abandoned house rumour) debunked respectfully; cultural team review.

name: The socially invisible person
summary_ar: يُغفَل شخص بسبب دوره الاجتماعي (عامل توصيل، حارس، موظف صيانة) فلا يُعدّ في قائمة الحاضرين. يكسر النمط القاعدة الطبقية القديمة التي استبعدت الخدم من الشبهة، ويعلّم الانتباه إلى من كان حاضراً فعلاً.
mystery_principle: Witnesses report 'nobody came' because they do not count certain roles as 'somebody'.
information_distribution: Logistics evidence (deliveries, shifts) present; witness statements omit role-holders.
surprise_mechanism: The overlooked role-holder was there.
fairness_criterion: Presence evidence for the role-holder must be in logs or documents before the gate; never make the culprit guilty because of class.
strengths: Teaches attention to who is counted
weaknesses: Risk of making service workers default suspects — mix roles across cases
athar_use: Use presence logs; across a season, vary which roles are culprits so no class is stigmatised.

name: Identity impersonation
summary_ar: شخص يعيش بهوية غيره، ولا تكشفه إلا تفاصيل سيرة صغيرة متناقضة. ينتج النمط مهام تحقق من الهوية عبر الوثائق والذكريات المشتركة.
mystery_principle: Assumed identity sustained until small biographical inconsistencies accumulate.
information_distribution: Several documents and acquaintances with partial knowledge of the real person.
surprise_mechanism: The person was never who she claimed.
fairness_criterion: At least two independent biographical inconsistencies must be discoverable; twins/doubles only if prepared (Knox 10).
weaknesses: Must avoid teaching ID fraud techniques
athar_use: 'Who is who?' verification mechanic with fictional records; no realistic forgery methods.

name: Time-shift (the event happened at another time)
name_ar: إزاحة الزمن: الحدث وقع في وقت آخر
summary_ar: يبدو المستحيل مستحيلاً لأن الجميع يفترض وقتاً خاطئاً للحدث. أداة الحل هي إعادة بناء الخط الزمني، والتمييز بين وقت وقوع الفعل ووقت اكتشافه.
mystery_principle: Discovery time is mistaken for event time.
information_distribution: Clues about earlier events (a missed meal, a changed routine) placed before the 'event'.
surprise_mechanism: The impossibility dissolves once the timeline shifts.
fairness_criterion: Earlier-event clues present; no undisclosed time-of-death science.
weaknesses: Time-of-death science must be accurate and non-operational (forensic team)
athar_use: Timeline-rebuild tool with 'when did it really happen?' prompt; forensic review of any time estimate.

name: Dossier / epistolary mystery
summary_ar: تُروى القضية كلها عبر وثائق (رسائل، رسائل نصية، محاضر، يوميات)، فيصبح القارئ هو المحقق. هذا أقرب نمط أدبي إلى واجهة ATHAR، وقد أثبت نجاحه تجارياً حديثاً.
mystery_principle: Each document is a partial, voiced viewpoint; the reader assembles the truth.
information_distribution: Documents with authors, dates and audiences; contradictions across documents.
surprise_mechanism: A document's author is revealed as unreliable or as the culprit.
fairness_criterion: All critical facts appear in at least one document; document metadata (author/date) visible.
weaknesses: Reading load; needs good filtering/search tools
athar_use: Primary case presentation format; in-app search, tagging and timeline-pinning of documents.

name: Nested mystery (story within the story)
summary_ar: وثيقة داخل القضية، مثل رواية أو قصة كتبتها شخصية، هي نفسها دليل على كاتبها. يضيف طبقة تحليل أدبي داخل اللغز.
mystery_principle: An embedded text encodes facts or motives about its in-world author.
information_distribution: The embedded text's 'fictional' details mirror real case facts.
surprise_mechanism: The missing chapter or encoded detail resolves the frame mystery.
fairness_criterion: The mapping between the embedded text and real facts must be discoverable without outside knowledge.
weaknesses: Double cognitive load (reviewers noted confusion)
athar_use: Use short embedded texts (a school-magazine story, a song lyric written for the case) at 16+.

name: Replay through different viewpoints
name_ar: إعادة اللعب عبر وجهات نظر مختلفة
summary_ar: يُعاد اليوم نفسه من منظور شخصيات مختلفة، فيكتشف المحقق ما يعرفه كل منها. ينتج آلية «إعادة» مناسبة للألعاب، لكنها معقدة.
mystery_principle: Knowledge is distributed across bodies; replay reveals hidden overlaps.
information_distribution: Each replay unlocks one perspective's knowledge and access.
surprise_mechanism: A detail seen from one viewpoint recontextualises another.
fairness_criterion: Every perspective needed for the solution must be unlockable without luck.
weaknesses: Rule complexity; confusion for younger users
athar_use: Late-season mechanic: replay a key hour as three witnesses in turn.

name: Apophenia trap (the seductive false pattern)
summary_ar: نمط مغرٍ يبدو أنه يربط الأحداث، ثم يتبين أنه مصادفة. يكافئ اختبار الأنماط بدلاً من الإعجاب بها، ويعلّم أن التطابق ليس سببية.
mystery_principle: Humans over-detect patterns; a coincidental pattern misleads the investigator.
information_distribution: Pattern visible early; disconfirming cases buried in data.
surprise_mechanism: The pattern was never the cause.
fairness_criterion: Disconfirming data must be present and findable; the pattern must not be the only route.
weaknesses: Frustrating if the pattern is too convincing
athar_use: Advanced case where the 'serial pattern' is coincidence; reward players who test the pattern against all cases.

name: Press-clipping analysis (reliability of reports)
summary_ar: التحقيق من المكتب عبر تقارير إعلامية متضاربة. يعلّم تقييم موثوقية المصادر، لكنه يحذر من الثقة المفرطة في حل لم يُؤكد.
mystery_principle: Second-hand reports differ in reliability; conclusions must be proportionate.
information_distribution: Several reports with differing sources, dates and errors.
surprise_mechanism: A widely repeated 'fact' traces back to one weak source.
fairness_criterion: Each report's provenance visible; at least one reliable primary document.
weaknesses: Poe's version is dull and over-confident; never fictionalise real victims
athar_use: 'Newsroom desk' mechanic: rate source reliability before use; calibrated confidence scoring.

name: Detective defeated / partial success
summary_ar: الخصم يتوقع خطوات المحقق ويتفوق عليه، والنهاية خسارة كريمة أو نجاح جزئي. يعلّم أن الخطأ جزء من التحقيق، ويتيح حالات نهاية متعددة.
mystery_principle: Investigators are fallible; outcomes can be partial.
information_distribution: Adversary has information about the investigator; cues allow anticipating the counter-move.
surprise_mechanism: The adversary was a step ahead.
fairness_criterion: Partial outcomes must still close the scored question; no unresolved core facts.
weaknesses: Players may feel cheated if the loss seems arbitrary
athar_use: Graded endings (full, partial, missed) tied to reasoning quality; the core mystery is always explained in the debrief.

name: Teen investigator reopens a settled case
summary_ar: بطل شاب، غالباً ضمن مشروع مدرسي، يعيد فحص قضية أغلقتها السلطات. النمط مثبت تجارياً في أدب اليافعين، ويتسق مع التموضع التعليمي لـATHAR.
mystery_principle: An outsider's fresh eyes and limited power drive a re-examination.
information_distribution: Access limited to what a teen can lawfully obtain: interviews, public records, school archives.
surprise_mechanism: The official account was incomplete.
fairness_criterion: No evidence that requires police powers or illegal access.
weaknesses: Must not encourage real-world vigilantism or harassment
athar_use: Default protagonist frame: student researchers with lawful, safe methods; explicit in-game ethics rules.

name: Investigator under a deadline (inverting the Three Apples)
name_ar: المحقق تحت مهلة: قلب حكاية التفاحات الثلاث
summary_ar: في الحكاية الأصلية ينتظر الوزير المهلة دون تحقيق، ويُحل اللغز بالاعتراف والمصادفة. ATHAR يأخذ الإطار التراثي (مهلة ثلاثة أيام) ويطلب من المستخدم أن يفعل ما لم يفعله جعفر: أن يحقق.
mystery_principle: External pressure with a ticking clock; contrasts chance and confession with investigation.
information_distribution: Clues released per 'day'; each day allows limited actions.
surprise_mechanism: Chance discovery vs earned discovery (debrief contrasts them).
fairness_criterion: Solution must be reachable by investigation within the action budget; no solution by chance.
weaknesses: Medieval content (dismemberment, slavery) needs heavy adaptation
athar_use: Heritage-inspired season opener: a court-style deadline frame in an original non-lethal case.

name: Environmental seal (untouched snow, sand, wet plaster)
summary_ar: سطح يسجل الآثار (ثلج، رمل، طلاء طري) يبدو أنه يثبت أن أحداً لم يقترب. يمكن تكييفه مع بيئات عربية: رمل مكنوس، أرض مبللة بعد الري، أرضية ممسوحة حديثاً.
mystery_principle: A trace-recording surface creates an apparent seal; its timing or extent is misread.
information_distribution: Surface condition and its timeline (when it was swept or wetted) shown.
surprise_mechanism: The seal formed after the act, or was bypassed by a visible route.
fairness_criterion: All routes and the timing of the surface change must be discoverable.
weaknesses: Must not teach how to avoid leaving traces
athar_use: Regional variants (desert sand, mopped courtyard); show principle only.

name: Interview-driven psychological procedural
summary_ar: المقابلة هي سطح اللعب الأساسي، والشخصية تحمل الشبهة. يوفر عمقاً عاطفياً، لكنه في الأدب المعاصر قد يترك خيوطاً بلا حل، وهذا ممنوع في القضية المقيَّمة.
mystery_principle: Character psychology and conversation reveal motive and inconsistency.
information_distribution: Testimony layered by trust level; follow-up questions unlock details.
surprise_mechanism: A sympathetic character's motive surfaces late.
fairness_criterion: All scored facts must be resolvable; emotional ambiguity is allowed only for unscored themes.
weaknesses: Ambiguity frustrates puzzle players; interview AI risks hallucination
athar_use: Scripted interview trees (not free LLM chat for facts); open emotional threads allowed but core facts closed.

name: Signposted rule-break (premium twist)
summary_ar: أكثر الروايات خلوداً كسرت قواعد العدالة التقليدية. يسمح ATHAR بكسر قاعدة واحدة محددة في المستويات المتقدمة، بشرط أن يكون الكسر عادلاً ومكتشفاً بإعادة القراءة، وأن يُعلن نوعه في الملخص الختامي.
mystery_principle: Expectations set by genre rules can be subverted for surprise if the subversion is itself clued.
information_distribution: Breach is foreshadowed by at least two subtle cues.
surprise_mechanism: Genre-expectation reversal.
fairness_criterion: Only rules in the 'breakable' list (see rulebook) may be broken; the debrief names the broken rule and its cues.
weaknesses: Destroys trust if used often or unfairly
athar_use: Max one signposted rule-break per season, at the top tier.

name: The unseen-object description (lost camel pattern)
name_ar: وصف ما لم يُرَ: نمط البعير الضال
summary_ar: يصف المحققون شيئاً لم يروه وصفاً دقيقاً من آثاره، فيُتهمون بأنهم رأوه أو سرقوه، ثم يبرئهم شرح القرائن. النمط موثق في حكاية أبناء نزار عند ابن الجوزي، ومنتشر في حكايات أوراسية (أمراء سرنديب، زاديغ) التي جعلها هكسلي مثالاً على «التنبؤ بالماضي».
mystery_principle: Accurate description of an unseen thing must come from traces; explaining the inference chain is the defence.
information_distribution: Player sees the traces first (as clue cards), then the accusation; the 'owner' testimony confirms each inferred trait one by one.
surprise_mechanism: The suspects' detailed knowledge, which looks like guilt, is revealed as inference.
fairness_criterion: Every inferred trait maps to a visible trace before the accusation scene.
strengths: Teaches that knowledge is not proof of presence
weaknesses: Motif is pan-Eurasian, not exclusively Arab
Original involves tribal ancestors (legendary)
athar_use: Season-1 tutorial: describe a missing drone/bag from its trail; player must defend the description to a sceptical owner.

name: The anachronistic object (time-stamp betrays the swap)
name_ar: الشيء الأحدث من روايته: المفارقة الزمنية
summary_ar: يُكشف الاستبدال أو التزوير لأن شيئاً في الدليل أحدث من التاريخ المزعوم: دراهم مضروبة بعد تاريخ الإيداع عند قاضي واسط، وزيتون طازج في جرة يُزعم أنها مغلقة منذ سبع سنين. يعلّم مقارنة «عمر الدليل» بعمر الرواية.
mystery_principle: Every object carries an implicit date; a claimed timeline must be compatible with all object dates.
information_distribution: Claimed date given in testimony; dating cue embedded in an item (mint year, version number, freshness) that the player must inspect.
surprise_mechanism: A neutral detail (coin inscription, olive freshness) contradicts the timeline.
fairness_criterion: The dating cue is inspectable and its meaning explained or learnable in-game (glossary/expert).
weaknesses: One-clue cases can feel trivial
Requires a plausible dating reference
athar_use: Archetype for 'Dar al-Sijil' document cases and digital 'file created after it was supposedly sent' cases.

name: The guilty-knowledge slip (has he reached the tree?)
name_ar: زلة المعرفة: هل بلغ صاحبك الشجرة؟
summary_ar: يُرسل المدّعي إلى مكان الواقعة ويُسأل المنكِر سؤالاً عرضياً عن المسافة، فيكشف جوابه أنه يعرف المكان. وردت الحكاية لإياس عند وكيع وابن الجوزي وابن القيم، ونُسبت أخرى مثلها إلى قاضٍ ببغداد، وهذا يدل على هجرة الحكاية بين الأسماء.
mystery_principle: A denier who knows details only a participant could know reveals participation; the slip must then be corroborated.
information_distribution: Interview transcripts with one detail only the culprit could know; independent evidence later confirms or refutes.
surprise_mechanism: An innocuous-seeming answer becomes the key.
fairness_criterion: The 'secret' detail is established as non-public earlier in the case; corroborating evidence exists.
weaknesses: Relies on a trick; may be read as endorsing deceptive interrogation
Slip alone is weak evidence
athar_use: Interview mechanic with a 'non-public facts' ledger; scoring requires corroboration (cf. ATH-SRC-0423).

name: Separate the witnesses
summary_ar: يقرر ابن القيم أن الحاكم إذا ارتاب بالشهود فرّقهم وسألهم كيف تحمّلوا الشهادة وأين، ويروي قصة عليّ مع رفاق المسافر الذين تناقضت رواياتهم حين سُئلوا منفصلين. وفي قصة الصحيفة ذات البياض تلقين متكرر لوّث ذاكرة الشهود.
mystery_principle: Independent accounts converge on truth; coordinated lies diverge on peripheral detail; repeated 'reminders' contaminate memory.
information_distribution: Each witness interviewed separately; a comparison table reveals divergences on details (route, times, who did what).
surprise_mechanism: The divergence is in details no one rehearsed.
fairness_criterion: All compared details are elicited in each interview; at least one honest-but-mistaken divergence exists to prevent 'any difference = lie'.
strengths: Natural fit for a comparison UI
weaknesses: Original story uses deception (staged takbir) and threats
Honest witnesses also differ
athar_use: Core interview-table mechanic; include 'honest error' noise so players learn that inconsistency is a signal, not proof.

name: The incentive trap (the bigger bait)
summary_ar: يُحمل المشتبه به على كشف نفسه بتغيير مصالحه لا باتهامه: إياس يعرض على الأمين الجاحد وديعة أكبر فيرد الصغرى، وعضد الدولة يسلّم علناً على المظلوم فيرد العطار العقد خوفاً. الحل بالضغط الاجتماعي، فهو حيلة تحتاج نقاشاً أخلاقياً.
mystery_principle: Behaviour under changed incentives reveals hidden intent.
information_distribution: Player knows the suspect's interests; designs or chooses a scenario that would make an honest and a dishonest suspect act differently.
surprise_mechanism: The suspect returns the property unprompted.
fairness_criterion: Both outcomes (honest/dishonest) are predictable from established motives.
weaknesses: Entrapment ethics; not a model for official investigation
Success does not prove guilt beyond the behaviour
athar_use: Use as an ethics debate node: player can propose a 'test', and the mentor discusses whether it is fair.

name: The trace that transfers (comb and wool)
summary_ar: كل احتكاك يترك أثراً: يسرّح إياس رأسي المتنازعين فيخرج صوف بلون القطيفة من كل منهما، وتكشف حمرة تربة واسط على ثوب الغريب بلده. هو أقرب نمط تراثي لمبدأ التبادل في العلوم الجنائية، مع حدوده.
mystery_principle: Contact leaves transfer; matching transferred material to its source links person and object.
information_distribution: Trace sample available on both object and person; player decides which comparison to run.
surprise_mechanism: A trivial detail (wool in hair) settles a two-party dispute.
fairness_criterion: Alternative transfer routes are mentioned and excluded within the case.
weaknesses: Overstates certainty if alternative transfers are ignored (ATH-SRC-0356)
athar_use: Beginner trace-evidence case with an explicit 'could it have got there another way?' step.

name: Records trail (castor roots to the culprit)
name_ar: سلسلة السجلات: من عروق الخروع إلى الفاعل
summary_ar: يُستدل على الفاعل بتتبع سجل غير مباشر: يسأل عضد الدولة الأطباء من وصف عروق الخروع، فيصل إلى المريض ثم الخادم ثم الشجرة. ويتتبع المعتضد جراباً عبر صانعه وبائعه ومشتريه. البنية صالحة للبحث في البيانات دون عنف.
mystery_principle: An unusual object implies a supply chain; each link is a record that narrows the population.
information_distribution: Player has access to several record sets (prescriptions, sales, delivery logs); only a chain of joins reaches the person.
surprise_mechanism: The culprit is an insider no one suspected, reached through mundane records.
fairness_criterion: Each join is supported by a record visible to the player; no unexplained leap.
weaknesses: Privacy concerns with medical records
The al-Mu'tadid version is a murder
athar_use: Mechanic: 'Pull the thread' screens joining fictional logs; privacy note on who may access records.

name: Consumption anomaly (fish bones in a poor alley)
name_ar: الإنفاق غير المتسق: عظام السمك في زقاق فقير
summary_ar: يلاحظ صاحب الشرطة عظام سمكة غالية على باب في زقاق فقير، فيستنتج إنفاقاً لا يناسب الحال. القرينة قائمة على المعدل الأساسي، وهي أيضاً موضع خطر التنميط الطبقي.
mystery_principle: Deviation from the expected base rate is a lead, not a verdict.
information_distribution: Background statistics of a setting are given; one item deviates; player must decide what further question it justifies.
surprise_mechanism: Mundane rubbish becomes the lead.
fairness_criterion: The anomaly has an innocent explanation available to test; the culprit is confirmed by independent evidence.
weaknesses: Can stigmatise poor neighbourhoods if used as proof
athar_use: Pair with ATHAR anti-stereotyping rule: anomaly unlocks an interview, never an accusation.

name: The planted-evidence frame-up
summary_ar: في كليلة ودمنة يدسّ الحاسدون لحم الملك في بيت ابن آوى ويتواطؤون في المجلس على اتهامه، وتنبه أم الأسد إلى سجله وإلى احتمال أن الخصوم هم الفاعلون. والنمط نفسه في قصة الأحدب: الجميع يظن أنه الفاعل.
mystery_principle: When all evidence comes from interested parties, map their interests before weighing it.
information_distribution: Evidence against the accused is abundant but every item traces to one group; a single neutral witness or record breaks the pattern.
surprise_mechanism: The overwhelming case collapses when provenance of evidence is checked.
fairness_criterion: Player can access the provenance (who found/reported each clue) of every item.
strengths: Strong moral lesson on hasty judgement
weaknesses: Original resolves by a trusted informant (deus ex machina)
athar_use: Season-1 mid-arc case: 'evidence provenance' view shows who supplied each clue.

name: The trial where the best speaker is guilty
summary_ar: باب الفحص عن أمر دمنة محاكمة كاملة: يقدّم دمنة أقوى المرافعات في الإثبات والاعتراف، ويسخر من اتهام قائم على الخِلقة، ولا يُدان إلا بشاهدين. وتختلف المخطوطات في هذا الباب أكثر من غيره.
mystery_principle: Persuasiveness is not evidence; procedural rules (corroboration) protect against both rhetoric and prejudice.
information_distribution: Hearing transcript with arguments of varying quality; evidence items separate; player scores arguments vs. evidence.
surprise_mechanism: The most convincing advocate turns out to be the culprit.
fairness_criterion: Decisive evidence available independently of the speeches.
weaknesses: Ends with execution; reason-of-state verdict
Versions differ
athar_use: Debate episode in a fictional student-council or museum board inquiry; rubric separates rhetoric from evidence.

name: The child who re-tries the case
summary_ar: في حكاية علي خواجه يحل الأطفال وهم يلعبون لعبة القاضي ما عجز عنه القاضي، بسؤال تجار الزيتون عن عمر الزيتون. وفي أخبار الأذكياء باب كامل لفطنة الصبيان، منه وقوف إياس صبياً أمام قاضي دمشق مطالباً بحقه.
mystery_principle: A fresh, unbiased look plus the right expert question can overturn an official conclusion.
information_distribution: Official file already closed; player reviews it and identifies the unasked question.
surprise_mechanism: The decisive question is simple and was overlooked by adults.
fairness_criterion: The missing question is answerable from evidence already in the file plus an available expert.
weaknesses: Ali Cogia's oldest form is Diyab's 1709 oral tale, not a medieval manuscript
Risk of mocking adult institutions
athar_use: Framing device for 'Shabakat al-Athar' trainees: reopen closed cases respectfully, with mentors.

name: The market inspector's test
summary_ar: تقدّم كتب الحسبة (الشيزري وابن الأخوة) لكل غش اختباراً بسيطاً: الطفو في الماء، والاحتراق، وفحص الميزان، وكسر الشمعة. ويكشف تطابق النصين أن الكتاب الثاني نقل عن الأول.
mystery_principle: Fraud is revealed by a property the fraudster could not fake (density, combustion, calibration).
information_distribution: Stall of products, a toolkit of safe virtual tests with costs; player chooses tests economically.
surprise_mechanism: The 'best' product fails a cheap test.
fairness_criterion: Each test's principle is shown before the case; results are deterministic in-game.
weaknesses: Must not teach adulteration recipes
Tasting tests only simulated
athar_use: Recurring 'souk inspector' mini-game; sources-comparison bonus task on text reuse.

name: The hidden message in plain words
summary_ar: يرسل الأسير العنبري تحذيراً بكلام ظاهره عادي (الشجر أورق، والنساء اشتكين) يفكه حكيم قومه. ويطلب حاجب ماءً بارداً في الشتاء علامة متفقاً عليها. وتنسب الدراسات إلى الكندي تحليل الشفرات بتكرار الحروف.
mystery_principle: Messages can carry meaning through context (metaphor) or statistics (letter frequency); decoding needs knowledge of sender and language.
information_distribution: A message plus context about its sender; for ciphers, enough text for frequency counts in Arabic.
surprise_mechanism: An innocent sentence turns out to be the key instruction.
fairness_criterion: All code mappings derivable from in-game context or a provided frequency table.
strengths: Arabic-language puzzles that cannot be machine-translated trivially
weaknesses: Avoid 'first ever' claims
Original contexts are raids and illicit meetings
athar_use: 'Dar al-Sijil' cipher strand with Arabic letter-frequency tool.

name: Solve-it-yourself micro-case (one planted inconsistency)
name_ar: قضية مصغّرة «حُلّها بنفسك»: تناقض واحد مزروع
summary_ar: قضية قصيرة جداً (300–500 كلمة) تخفي تناقضاً منطقياً أو معرفياً واحداً، ويُطلب من القارئ أن يجده قبل قراءة الحل في آخر الكتاب. هذه صيغة إنسايكلوبيديا براون والألغاز ذات الدقيقتين، وهي الأقرب إلى «لغز اليوم» في تطبيق هاتف.
mystery_principle: A single contradiction in an otherwise plausible statement betrays the liar or the error.
information_distribution: Full scene in one screen; the inconsistency is in the text, not in outside trivia; answer withheld until the player commits.
surprise_mechanism: The detail everyone read past (a fact that cannot be true).
fairness_criterion: The contradiction must be detectable from the text plus common school knowledge listed in the case metadata; no specialist trivia.
strengths: Very cheap to produce at scale
weaknesses: Sobol-style solutions often rely on trivia — fairness risk
Repetitive if not varied
athar_use: Daily "قضية الدقيقتين": one inconsistency, commit-then-reveal, explanation card linking to a reasoning skill; editor checks the knowledge-requirement field.

name: Distributed-clue team game (paired heirs)
name_ar: لعبة الأدلة الموزعة على الفرق (الورثة المزدوجون)
summary_ar: تُوزَّع أجزاء مختلفة من الأدلة على أزواج من اللاعبين، ولا يستطيع أي زوج الحل وحده؛ النجاح يتطلب تبادل المعلومات مع المنافسين. هذه بنية «لعبة ويستنغ»، وهي مناسبة للصف المدرسي والجلسات الجماعية في ATHAR.
mystery_principle: Truth is distributed; competition and cooperation must be balanced to reach it.
information_distribution: Each pair receives a partial, sometimes misleading clue set; a public board shows what has been shared.
surprise_mechanism: An identity hidden in plain sight emerges only when fragments are combined.
fairness_criterion: The union of all clue sets is sufficient and minimal; no single team set suffices.
weaknesses: Free-rider problem
Hard to balance in asynchronous play
athar_use: Classroom mode: 4–8 pairs, each with a sealed clue packet; scoring credits verified exchanges; teacher dashboard shows information flow.

name: Genre-literate mystery club (self-reflexive honkaku)
summary_ar: أبطال ينتمون إلى نادٍ يقرأ الروايات البوليسية ويناقش قواعدها، ثم يجدون أنفسهم داخل لغز يتطلب تطبيق تلك القواعد أو كسرها. نشأ هذا في الشين هونكاكو الياباني وفي حوار أكيتشي في المقهى، ويجعل قواعد اللعب العادل جزءاً من الحكاية نفسها.
mystery_principle: Characters who know detective-fiction rules make the fairness contract explicit inside the story.
information_distribution: Club members voice competing theories and cite genre rules; the reader is addressed directly before the solution.
surprise_mechanism: A rule the club treated as sacred is the one the culprit exploited.
fairness_criterion: Every rule invoked by characters is honoured or its breach is signposted (Atlas principle 48).
weaknesses: Can feel insular or smug
Requires prior genre knowledge
athar_use: ATHAR school "نادي الأثر" as recurring cast; club debates become hint ladder steps; a "challenge to the player" screen in the club's voice.

name: Impossible challenge without a victim (the wager)
summary_ar: رهان على أن العقل وحده يحل مشكلة تبدو مستحيلة، مثل الخروج من زنزانة محكمة في «مسألة الزنزانة 13». الغموض هو «كيف» وليس «من»، ولا يوجد ضحية، فيصلح للفئة الأصغر.
mystery_principle: An apparently impossible outcome is explained by a chain of ordinary actions.
information_distribution: The constraints are fully stated at the start; the player sees the outcome, then reconstructs the method from traces.
surprise_mechanism: Small, earlier preparations (planted before the "impossible" moment) explain everything.
fairness_criterion: All enabling facts are visible before the reveal; no hidden technology.
weaknesses: Period solutions use dated technology
Can become a trick puzzle
athar_use: Weekly "المستحيل" challenge: a sealed room/box/exam paper problem with no victim; scoring on listing constraints and testing each.

name: The decoded hoax (correct decryption, false reality)
summary_ar: يفك البطل الشيفرة فكاً صحيحاً، ثم يتبين أن الرسالة نفسها مزروعة للخداع. في «نقود النحاس ذات السنَّين» لرانبو يكون التشفير محكماً، لكن الحكاية كلها مقلب. الدرس: صحة فك الرمز لا تعني صحة ما يقوله الرمز.
mystery_principle: Decoding a message tests skill; trusting it is a separate question of provenance.
information_distribution: Cipher fully solvable; provenance clues (who could have planted it, when) are present but easy to ignore.
surprise_mechanism: The message was authored by someone who wanted it found.
fairness_criterion: Provenance clues must appear before the reveal; cipher solvable without outside knowledge.
strengths: Combines puzzle joy with source criticism
weaknesses: Players may feel cheated if provenance clues are too faint
athar_use: Two-stage scoring: (1) decode, (2) assess "who wrote this and why?" — tie to the source-evaluation skill.

name: Mundane object as message channel
summary_ar: رسالة مخبأة في شيء يومي: أرقام على مِعداد، أو نمط في دفتر يوميات، أو ترتيب كتب. لا جريمة غالباً، والغموض في فهم المقصود. هذا نمط قصص رانبو القصيرة (1925) ومناسب لقضايا V0.
mystery_principle: Ordinary objects can carry intentional signals; the puzzle is noticing the pattern and its intended reader.
information_distribution: Object shown repeatedly; small changes over time are the clue.
surprise_mechanism: The "message" was meant for someone else, or was misread entirely.
fairness_criterion: Pattern must be visible in the object states the player can inspect.
strengths: Teaches pattern noticing vs. apophenia (link KO-NP-02-025)
weaknesses: Romantic framing in sources must be adapted
athar_use: V0 case set in school/office: player logs object states across days, infers the code and its intended recipient.

name: Inquest walk-through (evidence in legal order)
summary_ar: تعرض الأدلة بالترتيب الذي تُقدَّم به في جلسة رسمية: الوقائع، ثم الشهود، ثم الخبراء، ثم القرائن الظرفية. هذه بنية «قضية ليفنوورث» وقصص العجوز في الزاوية. يفيد ATHAR في تعليم الفرق بين الواقعة والاستنتاج داخل إطار قانوني.
mystery_principle: Evidence acquires meaning through the order and context in which it is tested.
information_distribution: Session-by-session release: facts → witnesses → expert → circumstantial; the player can object or ask follow-ups.
surprise_mechanism: An expert or circumstantial point that seemed decisive is reframed by a later witness.
fairness_criterion: Each session releases evidence available to all parties; no secret evidence at the verdict.
weaknesses: Can feel slow
Real procedures differ by country — label as generic
athar_use: Optional "جلسة استماع" mode for 16-18: structured rounds with objections; ties to forensic library on expert limits.

name: Disputed-object reaction test
name_ar: اختبار ردّ الفعل على الشيء المتنازع عليه
summary_ar: قاضٍ يحسم نزاعاً بلا شهود بإجراء يكشف ردّ فعل الطرفين، كتمزيق المظلة المتنازع عليها في «قضايا القاضي باو» ثم مراقبة من يغضب. في ATHAR يُستخدم النمط مادةً للنقاش: هل ردّ الفعل دليل كافٍ؟
mystery_principle: Emotional investment can reveal ownership — but it is weak, manipulable evidence.
information_distribution: Dispute stated; no witnesses; the "test" and the reactions are shown.
surprise_mechanism: The reaction identifies the owner; the debrief asks whether that inference was safe.
fairness_criterion: Debrief must present at least one alternative explanation of the reaction (Atlas principle 46).
strengths: Links to Arabic qadi anecdotes (heritage team)
weaknesses: Risk of teaching that demeanour proves guilt
Deception by authority
athar_use: Use as "هل كان الحكم عادلاً؟" discussion cards after cases, not as an accepted method; cross-reference KO-NP-02H-003/005.

name: Hidden will inside an ordinary object
summary_ar: وثيقة حاسمة (وصية، سند) مخبأة داخل لوحة أو ساعة أو كتاب، ويقود فحص الشيء بعناية إلى إنصاف شخص مظلوم. نجده في «قضايا القاضي باو» (اللوحة التي تشير إلى الأرض) وفي «سر الساعة القديمة». نمط ميراث بلا عنف يناسب الأسر العربية.
mystery_principle: A deceased person anticipated injustice and left a solvable trail.
information_distribution: The object is given early with an ambiguous instruction; physical details of the object are the clues.
surprise_mechanism: The instruction meant something literal about the object itself.
fairness_criterion: All features needed to find the document are inspectable in the object viewer.
weaknesses: Inheritance disputes can be culturally sensitive; avoid religious-law rulings
athar_use: Object-inspection case: zoom, rotate, measure; solution unlocks a document whose content resolves the dispute.

name: Two-track investigation: hearing room and street
name_ar: التحقيق على مسارين: قاعة الجلسة والشارع
summary_ar: تتناوب الحكاية بين جلسات علنية يستجوب فيها القاضي، وتحريات ميدانية هادئة يجمع فيها المعلومات بين الناس، كما في «قضايا القاضي دي» و«قضايا القاضي بنغ». في ATHAR يتحول هذا إلى إيقاع: جمع في الميدان، ثم عرض في الجلسة.
mystery_principle: Public confrontation only works after quiet fieldwork has produced verifiable facts.
information_distribution: Field phases unlock facts; hearing phases test them against suspects' statements.
surprise_mechanism: A statement in the hearing contradicts what the field already established.
fairness_criterion: Every hearing contradiction must trace to a field-collected fact.
strengths: Cultural bridge (judge tales East and West)
weaknesses: Source tales use disguise and torture — ATHAR keeps fieldwork lawful and consent-based
athar_use: Core loop for longer cases: "ميدان" (interviews, records, observation) then "مواجهة" (structured questioning without coercion).

name: Parallel docket (several cases at once)
summary_ar: المحقق يتعامل مع عدة قضايا غير مترابطة في وقت واحد، وقد يتبين أن بينها رابطاً. هذه سمة أساسية في أدب «الگونگ آن»، وتفيد في تصميم موسم تتقاطع فيه قضايا صغيرة.
mystery_principle: Interleaving cases tests discrimination: which clue belongs to which case?
information_distribution: Two or three small cases share time and locations; some clues are cross-relevant.
surprise_mechanism: Two apparently separate cases share one cause or actor.
fairness_criterion: Each case is solvable alone; the link is a bonus discovery with its own evidence.
strengths: Interleaved practice is good for transfer (learning library)
weaknesses: Cognitive overload for 13-15
athar_use: Season mode for 16+: a "دفتر قضايا" with 3 open files; optional link-discovery achievement.

name: Reverse-chronology career
summary_ar: تبدأ الحكاية بآخر قضايا المحقق وتعود إلى أولها، فيرى القارئ السمعة قبل الأفعال، ويفهم أصولها تدريجياً. هذه بنية «13.67» عبر ست قضايا من 2013 إلى 1967، وتصلح لموسم أرشيفي عن تاريخ مدينة.
mystery_principle: Knowing the end changes how earlier events are read; each step back recontextualises the previous case.
information_distribution: One case per era, played from newest to oldest; recurring characters age backwards.
surprise_mechanism: The final (earliest) case reveals the origin of a habit or relationship seen from the start.
fairness_criterion: Each case is self-contained and fair; the cross-case reveal is a bonus.
weaknesses: Adult political content in source
Complex for younger players
athar_use: Heritage season for 18-24: a city's archive told backwards through a retired investigator's files.

name: Alternating dual timeline (then/now)
summary_ar: فصول تتناوب بين حدث قديم لم يُحل وتحقيق حاضر، وتظهر وثائق الماضي أدلةً للحاضر. هذه بنية «ماكر حقاً»، وتتكامل مع نمط القضية الباردة في المكتبة.
mystery_principle: The past case explains the present one; documents bridge eras.
information_distribution: Alternating chapters: archival scenes (fixed truth) and present investigation (player-driven).
surprise_mechanism: A present-day clue reinterprets an old document.
fairness_criterion: Archival scenes shown to the player contain no information the in-world investigator lacks access to, or the gap is labelled.
strengths: Rich for heritage and local history
weaknesses: Must not use real historical victims (Atlas 44)
athar_use: Use with fictional local archives: "then" vignettes as playable flashbacks unlocked by present-day document finds.

name: Many secrets, one crime
summary_ar: كل المشتبه بهم يخفون شيئاً، لكن واحداً فقط يخفي ما يتعلق بالحادث. تعرض «واحد منا يكذب» الحكاية بأصوات المشتبه بهم بالتناوب، وكل منهم يكذب لسبب لا علاقة له بالجريمة. الدرس: الكذب ليس دليلاً على الجرم.
mystery_principle: Concealment has many motives; the investigator must link each secret to its real object.
information_distribution: Each suspect narrates a chapter; secrets are revealed one by one and sorted into "related/unrelated".
surprise_mechanism: The most suspicious secret-holder is innocent of this event.
fairness_criterion: Every unrelated secret is fully explained by case end (red herrings resolved — Atlas 21).
weaknesses: Secrets involving sexuality or family shame need cultural sensitivity
athar_use: Suspect board with a "secret" column; scoring rewards correct classification of each secret, not just naming the culprit.

name: Sealed-space vanishing (non-lethal)
name_ar: الاختفاء من مكان مغلق دون عنف
summary_ar: شخص يدخل مكاناً محكماً (كبسولة عين لندن) ولا يخرج منه، ولا يوجد قتل. يضع المحققون فرضيات متعددة ويستبعدونها واحدة واحدة. نسخة آمنة للمراهقين من لغز الغرفة المغلقة.
mystery_principle: Systematically enumerate and test every way out.
information_distribution: The sealed space is mapped; witness positions and times are fixed; each hypothesis has a test.
surprise_mechanism: The "impossible" assumption (who entered, or when) was false.
fairness_criterion: Hypothesis list exhaustible with given data; the true one is testable before the reveal.
weaknesses: Missing-person anxiety for young players — ensure safe outcome
athar_use: Hypothesis tracker UI: player lists ways, marks evidence for/against; reveal checks completeness of list.

name: Sinister appearance, innocent explanation
summary_ar: موقف يبدو جريمة (اختطاف، تهديد، سرقة) يتبين أنه عمل غريب أو مهنة غير مألوفة أو سوء فهم. هذه بنية «نادي المهن الغريبة»، وتخدم هدف ATHAR بأن تكون 20–30% من القضايا بلا جانٍ.
mystery_principle: The innocent hypothesis must always be on the board.
information_distribution: Alarming surface details first; mundane explanatory details are present but de-emphasised.
surprise_mechanism: Everyone assumed a crime; the truth is unusual but harmless.
fairness_criterion: Innocent explanation is fully supported by inspectable evidence; no "it was all a dream".
strengths: Breaks the habit of hunting a culprit
weaknesses: Players may feel the stakes were fake — pair with a real cost of false accusation
athar_use: ARC-04-style cases: score includes "did you consider no-crime?"; an NPC nearly punished unjustly raises stakes.

name: Solve-along serial with reader submissions
name_ar: السلسلة التي يحلها القراء أثناء نشرها
summary_ar: تُنشر القضية على حلقات ويُدعى القراء لإرسال حلولهم قبل الحلقة الأخيرة، كما حدث مع «لغز بيغ بو» في صحيفة The Star سنة 1891. هذا أصل تاريخي لبوابة الحل الأسبوعية في ATHAR.
mystery_principle: A fixed solution plus a public submission window creates communal suspense.
information_distribution: Weekly episodes; all clues released before a submission deadline; solution episode after.
surprise_mechanism: Public reveal compares the community's top theories with the truth.
fairness_criterion: Solution locked (hashed) before the first episode; all clues released before the deadline.
weaknesses: Spoilers and answer-sharing; need fair-play integrity
athar_use: Weekly community case with hashed solution, theory leaderboard (reasoning quality, not speed), and solution livestream/explainer.

name: Elder's casebook frame
summary_ar: محقق متقاعد يروي قضاياه القديمة لراوٍ شاب، فتصير كل قضية ذكرى تُستعاد. هذه بنية «سجل قضايا هانشيتشي» (1917)، وتشبه جلسات الحكي العائلية في الثقافة العربية.
mystery_principle: The storyteller knows the answer and paces it; the listener (player) reasons alongside.
information_distribution: Elder tells the case in instalments, pausing to ask the listener's view.
surprise_mechanism: The elder reveals what he got wrong at the time, or what he never told anyone.
fairness_criterion: The elder never withholds a fact he describes having known at that point of the story.
weaknesses: Risk of nostalgia over accuracy; elder must be fallible (KO-CD-02-002)
athar_use: Recurring "جدّ الحكايات" narrator in a heritage season; pauses become challenge gates.

name: Non-visual evidence channel (sound, touch, smell)
name_ar: قناة الأدلة غير البصرية (صوت، لمس، رائحة)
summary_ar: أدلة تُدرك بالسمع أو اللمس أو الشم، كما يفعل المحقق الكفيف ماكس كارادوس. يخدم هذا تصميماً شاملاً لذوي الإعاقة البصرية، ويكسر الاعتماد على الصور وحدها.
mystery_principle: Some truths are only available through non-visual channels.
information_distribution: Audio clips, texture descriptions and smell notes are evidence objects with their own inspection tools.
surprise_mechanism: The decisive clue was a sound everyone heard but no one listened to.
fairness_criterion: Every non-visual clue has a text alternative; no clue requires perfect hearing.
weaknesses: Over-romanticising disability ("super-senses")
athar_use: Audio-evidence cards (accessible transcripts) in at least one case per season; consult disabled testers.

name: Technical match is not guilt (provenance challenge)
summary_ar: دليل علمي يبدو قاطعاً، كبصمة إصبع مطابقة، يتبين أنه مزروع أو منقول. في «بصمة الإبهام الحمراء» (1907) يُثبت الدفاع أن البصمة نفسها يمكن أن تُصنع. الدرس: السؤال ليس «هل تطابق؟» بل «كيف وصلت إلى هنا؟».
mystery_principle: Evidence has a history; its path matters as much as its match.
information_distribution: Match result shown early with high confidence; custody and context details are scattered.
surprise_mechanism: The match is genuine but the trace was transferred or planted.
fairness_criterion: The provenance flaw is discoverable from documented custody/context; no method of forgery is described operationally.
weaknesses: Must not teach how to fake traces (safety rule)
athar_use: Evidence cards carry a "custody timeline"; players earn credit for questioning provenance; forensic team (04) reviews every such case.

name: Frozen-moment reconstruction
summary_ar: القضية لحظة واحدة مجمدة يجب أن يستنتج منها المستخدم ما حدث قبلها وبعدها ومن فعل ولماذا. نمط Golden Idol وObra Dinn. قوته الكثافة والقابلية للتقييم، وضعفه الطابع الساكن.
mystery_principle: All clues co-present in one moment; truth hidden in combination
information_distribution: Front-loaded in a single scene, unlocked by inspection
surprise_mechanism: Recombination of innocuous details
fairness_criterion: Every slot answerable from scene evidence; no outside knowledge
weaknesses: Static; low character arc
athar_use: Core case format for 13-18 cases

name: Archive-of-fragments
summary_ar: الحقيقة موزعة على شظايا (مقاطع، رسائل) يصل إليها المستخدم بالبحث، فيتكون السرد من ترتيب الاكتشاف. نمط Her Story وTelling Lies. خطره فقدان التحكم بالإيقاع وحرق المفاجأة.
mystery_principle: Ambiguity sustained by fragmentation
information_distribution: Player-pulled via queries
surprise_mechanism: Late reinterpretation of early fragments
fairness_criterion: Critical reveals gated behind compound queries
weaknesses: Spoiler risk; costly Arabic search; ambiguity
athar_use: Advanced cases and archival research tracks

name: Knowledge-gated exploration
summary_ar: العالم مفتوح لكن التقدم يتطلب فهم واقعة، فيتطابق التعلم والتقدم. نمط Outer Wilds. يتطلب قرائن متعددة وإشارات إلى مواضع القرائن التالية.
mystery_principle: Curiosity driven by unexplained phenomena
information_distribution: Distributed; each text points to the next
surprise_mechanism: Understanding transforms meaning of known places
fairness_criterion: Each gate supported by multiple discoverable clues
weaknesses: Getting stuck
athar_use: Season-level arc and chapter gates

name: Loop investigation
summary_ar: يتكرر اليوم أو الزيارة ويحتفظ المستخدم بمعرفته، فيصبح الخطأ أداة استكشاف. نمط The Forgotten City وOuter Wilds. مكلف في المحتوى ويناسب القضايا المتقدمة.
mystery_principle: Repetition reveals hidden schedules and rules
information_distribution: Accumulates across loops
surprise_mechanism: Discovering a rule's true cause
fairness_criterion: Knowledge persists; no permanent loss
weaknesses: Repetition fatigue; cost
athar_use: Advanced special episodes

name: Testimony contradiction duel
summary_ar: تقوم القضية على إفادات تُفحص جملة جملة وتُواجه بالأدلة حتى تنهار. نمط Ace Attorney. قوته الإثارة والوضوح، وضعفه الخطية وقبول دليل واحد.
mystery_principle: Lies exposed through evidence-statement conflict
information_distribution: Evidence pre-collected, testimony revealed live
surprise_mechanism: Contradiction turns witness or reveals new suspect
fairness_criterion: All valid contradicting evidence accepted
weaknesses: Linear; trial-and-error
athar_use: Mid-season contradiction cases

name: Open trial with fixed truth
summary_ar: يحقق المستخدم بحرية ويقدم قضيته متى شاء أمام حقيقة لا تتغير. نمط Paradise Killer. يحتاج مراجعة ما بعد الحكم كي يصلح تعليمياً.
mystery_principle: Player decides sufficiency
information_distribution: Fully open world
surprise_mechanism: Player-built case; potential wrong conviction
fairness_criterion: Fixed truth; no tricks on player
weaknesses: No learning feedback in original
athar_use: Finale cases with post-verdict review

name: Unresolvable interpretation
summary_ar: القضية مصممة بلا حل وحيد ليكون التعليل لا الصواب هو المقياس. نمط Pentiment. عادل فقط إذا أُعلن مسبقاً ولا يُستخدم لتقييم صحة الاستنتاج.
mystery_principle: Deliberate uncertainty
information_distribution: Limited time forces partial view
surprise_mechanism: Hindsight suggests but never confirms
fairness_criterion: Declared upfront as open-interpretation
weaknesses: Not assessable for correctness
athar_use: Separate ethics/history track only

name: Provisional knowledge decoding
summary_ar: يبني المستخدم فهمه تدريجياً عبر تخمينات قابلة للمراجعة مع درجات ثقة. نمط Heaven's Vault. يعلّم المعايرة لكنه قد يحبط إن تأخر اعتراف النظام بالفهم.
mystery_principle: Meaning emerges via cross-reference
information_distribution: Spread across many inscriptions
surprise_mechanism: Re-reading earlier texts with new knowledge
fairness_criterion: Early submission allowed with evidence
weaknesses: System lag; slow
athar_use: Code/language and archival puzzles

name: Elimination funnel
summary_ar: يبدأ المستخدم بعدة مشتبهين متقاربين في الدافع والوسيلة والفرصة ويستبعدهم بالأدلة. أعادت Painscreek بناء فصل بهذا النمط، وتعطي Golden Idol المشتبهين صفات متشابهة. يحتاج توازناً كي لا يصبح تصفية آلية.
mystery_principle: Similar suspects; alibis and impossibilities
information_distribution: Evidence per suspect across locations
surprise_mechanism: Last remaining suspect or unexpected re-entry
fairness_criterion: At least two suspects with means/motive/opportunity
weaknesses: Can be mechanical
athar_use: Core early-season whodunits

name: Messenger mystery
summary_ar: تُروى القصة عبر تطبيق مراسلة داخل الهاتف بصور ورسائل صوتية ومكالمات. نمط Duskwood المصنف 13+. جذاب ومألوف للمراهقين لكن استنتاجه ضعيف ما لم تُضف آليات استدلال.
mystery_principle: Suspense via real-time-feeling messages
information_distribution: Drip-fed by episode
surprise_mechanism: Message reveals betrayal or hidden identity
fairness_criterion: Deduction tasks must be embedded, not only choices
weaknesses: Weak deduction; monetization risks
athar_use: Wrapper for case delivery and hints

name: Conflicting Testimonies (Rashomon-style, honest witnesses)
summary_ar: ثلاث روايات أو أكثر لحدث واحد، كلها صادقة من منظور أصحابها لكنها متعارضة. يبني اللاعب الرواية الأرجح ويفسّر سبب الاختلاف. مبني على منهج التاريخ الشفهي، ويناسب الثقافة الشفهية القوية في المجتمعات العربية.
mystery_principle: What actually happened, and why do honest accounts diverge?
information_distribution: Each witness holds partial, perspective-bound truth; one documentary anchor (photo, record) arbitrates some points.
surprise_mechanism: The 'odd' detail in the least credible account turns out to be accurate.
fairness_criterion: Every divergence must be explainable by position, memory or meaning stated in-game; no hidden liar unless clued.
weaknesses: Text-heavy
Hard to auto-assess explanations
athar_use: Season arcs in 'Dhakirat al-Hayy'; LOCAL_STORY_OPPORTUNITIES #9, #11.

name: The Travelling Image (verification mystery)
summary_ar: مادة رقمية منتشرة (صورة أو مقطع أو تصريح) تبدو دليلاً على حدث، ويتتبعها اللاعب إلى سياقها الأصلي. يستجيب لانتشار الأخبار المختلقة واعتماد الشباب على وسائل التواصل مصدراً للأخبار.
mystery_principle: Is this real, and where did it come from?
information_distribution: Clues in metadata-like hints, background details, earlier copies, original source.
surprise_mechanism: The image is real but from another time/place; or the quote is real but truncated.
fairness_criterion: All verification steps doable with in-game tools; no real-world tools or real events.
weaknesses: Risk of teaching cynicism
Real tools change fast - keep principles generic
athar_use: 'Tahaqquq' unit cases; LOCAL_STORY_OPPORTUNITIES #12-#16.

name: The Document Puzzle (authenticity and dating)
summary_ar: وثيقة أو مخطوطة يُشك في أصالتها أو تاريخها، ويحل اللاعب اللغز بقراءة الأدلة المادية (حبر، وورق، وخط، وأختام) ونقد المصدر. مستلهم من مجموعات المخطوطات والأرشيف الرقمية العربية، مع تعليم أن الأرشيف نفسه له منظور.
mystery_principle: Is this what it claims to be, and who benefits if it isn't?
information_distribution: Physical clues on the object; external records (catalogues, letters); a motive layer.
surprise_mechanism: The 'forgery' is genuine but mis-catalogued; or the genuine part is the margin, not the text.
fairness_criterion: Material-science claims reviewed by library 04; no real forgery techniques taught.
weaknesses: Needs expert review for each material claim
Rights clearance if real images used
athar_use: 'Dar al-Sijill' cases; LOCAL_STORY_OPPORTUNITIES #1-#4.

name: The Wrongly Suspected Outsider
summary_ar: المشتبه به الأول شخص من فئة مهمشة، تشير إليه أدلة ظرفية وأحكام مسبقة، ثم تبرّئه الأدلة. يُسمّى التحيز الذي قاد إلى الاتهام موضوعاً تعليمياً. مبني على أدبيات أثر الصور النمطية الإعلامية، ويحوّل خطر التنميط إلى درس.
mystery_principle: Who did it, and why did we suspect the wrong person?
information_distribution: Early circumstantial clues + social cues point at outsider; decisive physical/timeline evidence exonerates.
surprise_mechanism: The trusted insider's small inconsistency outweighs the outsider's 'suspicious' behaviour, which has an innocent explanation.
fairness_criterion: Exonerating evidence available before accusation; the true culprit is not from another stigmatised group.
weaknesses: If overused becomes predictable
Could still reinforce stereotype if exoneration is weak
athar_use: LOCAL_STORY_OPPORTUNITIES #16, #19; requires sensitivity review.

name: The 'lesson-tale' (عبرة) case frame from Gulf story podcasts
name_ar: إطار «القصة ذات العبرة» المستلهم من بودكاست القصص الخليجية
summary_ar: البرامج المتصدرة تقدم قصص الجريمة بوصفها حكايات واقعية «للتسلية والعبرة» مع مشاركة المستمعين. يقترح هذا النمط أن يختتم كل فصل من قضية متخيلة بلحظة «ماذا تعلمنا؟» تربط الأدلة بقرار أخلاقي أو عملي، بما يتوافق مع اشتراط التصنيف السعودي إظهار عواقب الجريمة. هذا نمط تصميمي مستوحى، لا نتيجة مختبرة على المراهقين.
plot_type: Short episodic case with moral resolution
mystery_principle: Who/what/why, resolved by evidence; the 'lesson' arises from the reasoning error or the consequence, not from preaching
information_distribution: Narrator-led, episodic clue drops; listener/player predictions invited before reveal
surprise_mechanism: The overlooked everyday detail (a habit, a receipt, a dialect word) explains the case
fairness_criterion: All decisive clues heard/seen before the reveal; lesson must follow from evidence, not from authority
weaknesses: Risk of moralising tone
Adult real-crime origin of the format
athar_use: Daily micro-case bridge and audio episodes; ending card 'what the evidence taught us'.

name: Three-episode case arc inside a season meta-mystery
name_ar: قوس القضية في ثلاث حلقات داخل لغز موسمي جامع
summary_ar: تتقاطع صيغ ناجحة على بنية واحدة: «القصة الكاملة» على شاهد (5 حكايات × 3 حلقات)، وSherlock & Co. (القضية الكلاسيكية في 3–4 أجزاء × 35 دقيقة)، ومسلسلات رمضان المصرية التي تكشف جريمة الحلقة الأولى على مدى الموسم، وDetective Conan (قضية الأسبوع مع خط سري طويل). النمط لـATHAR: كل قضية = 3 جلسات (العرض والأدلة الأولى / التحقيق والمختبر / المواجهة والحجة)، ويُزرع في كل قضية دليل صغير على لغز الموسم يُحل في الحلقة الأخيرة.
plot_type: Anthology of short cases with a serialized meta-arc
mystery_principle: Closure per case (satisfaction) plus an open season question (retention).
information_distribution: Session 1: crime and 40% of evidence; session 2: lab results and interviews; session 3: confrontation and justification. One meta-clue per case.
surprise_mechanism: Meta-clues reinterpreted in the finale; each case's own twist at session 3.
fairness_criterion: Each case solvable without the meta-arc; the meta-mystery solvable from collected meta-clues alone.
strengths: Fits classroom periods (one session = one lesson)
Validated by current Arab streaming formats
weaknesses: Meta-arc adds authoring dependency across cases
Players who skip cases miss meta-clues
athar_use: Default season template: 8 cases x 3 sessions + finale; meta-clue tracker in the case notebook.

name: Investigator who must justify past reasoning to an auditor (frame for reasoning assessment)
name_ar: المحقق الذي يُسأل عن تبرير استدلاله أمام مدقّق (إطار سردي لتقييم الاستدلال)
summary_ar: في المسلسل السعودي «رهن التحقيق» يروي المحقق تركي قضاياه السابقة وهو نفسه قيد التحقيق، فيضطر إلى تبرير كل خطوة قانونياً وأخلاقياً. هذه بنية سردية تحوّل تقييم الاستدلال إلى دراما: بعد حل القضية يواجه اللاعب «مدقّقاً» داخل القصة يسأل: لماذا هذا الدليل كافٍ؟ ما البديل الذي استبعدته؟ هل كان الإجراء قانونياً؟ وتدعمها صيغة Only Murders التي يسجّل فيها الأبطال بودكاست عن قضيتهم، وصيغة Poirot في جمع المشتبهين وتبرئة كل منهم بسبب.
plot_type: Frame narrative: review board / internal audit of a solved case
mystery_principle: Tension shifts from 'who did it' to 'was the reasoning sound and lawful'.
information_distribution: Auditor reveals one overlooked fact per challenge, testing whether the player's argument survives.
surprise_mechanism: A challenge exposes that the accusation relied on an unverified assumption; player may revise.
fairness_criterion: Every auditor challenge is answerable from evidence the player had; no new decisive evidence introduced at audit.
weaknesses: Risk of feeling like an exam
Needs careful tone for 13-15
athar_use: Post-accusation 'review' scene scored with the argument rubric; auditor is a fixed recurring character.

name: Heritage judge-trickster micro-case (Juha / Qadi) as a family-safe audio format
name_ar: القضية القصيرة بطلها قاضٍ أو جحا: صيغة تراثية صوتية آمنة للأسرة
summary_ar: مسلسل «جحا» من صوت حاضر في أعلى 100 بودكاست في الدول الست، وحلقاته في سبتمبر 2026 قضايا يحكم فيها جحا (سرقة الذهب في جرة الزيتون، وسرقة الشبكة) في 8–10 دقائق. ومعه برنامج «ألف ليلة وليلة» الإذاعي الذي امتد 26 عاماً وأكثر من 800 حلقة. النمط: قضية قصيرة بلا عنف (سرقة، خداع، نزاع) يحسمها قاضٍ ذكي بحيلة استدلالية من التراث العام، تُقدَّم صوتياً مع سؤال للمستمع قبل الحكم. مناسبة للفئة 13–15 والأسرة، ومصدرها نصوص ملك عام يعمل عليها فريق التراث.
mystery_principle: Who is lying and how a clever test reveals it.
information_distribution: Both claims stated; one physical detail planted early; judge's test resolves it.
surprise_mechanism: The test (e.g., weighing, smell, timing) exposes the liar.
fairness_criterion: The decisive physical detail is stated before the pause question.
weaknesses: Can feel childish to 16+
Some heritage tales carry outdated norms needing adaptation
athar_use: Free weekly 8-10 min 'Qadi case' audio as top-of-funnel and classroom warm-up; links to the full case app.
